name: flood
description: Find Flood components, design rules, tokens and skills for building interfaces.

interface.longDescription: Search the public Flood design system. Read component APIs, tokens, recipes and design guidance with links to the source documentation.
defaultPrompt: Plan a Flood table with filters and bulk actions.
Find a Flood recipe for sidebar navigation with a contextual pane.
Compare the Flood components for showing a trend over time.

positive.prompt: Use Flood to report its public catalog version and link me to the MCP connection guide.
positive.expected_behavior: Report the version returned by Flood and link to the public MCP connection guide.

positive.description: Find a table recipe by task
positive.prompt: Use Flood to find the recipe for a table with filters and bulk actions. Explain how it keeps selection and action scope clear.
positive.expected_behavior: Find and read the Table bulk actions recipe, describe host-owned selection and action scope, and link to the recipe.

positive.prompt: Use Flood to find the Navigation workspace recipe and summarize how it separates route state and pane state.
positive.expected_behavior: Find and read the Navigation workspace recipe, summarize its ownership of route and pane state, and link to the recipe.

positive.prompt: Open Flood material component:line-chart. Explain when to use it and point me to its component documentation.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the public LineChart material and summarize the documented use case with a link to the component page.

positive.prompt: Find Flood ScrollArea and read its example. How do I keep content width stable when vertical overflow appears?
positive.expected_behavior: Find ScrollArea, explain its overlay scrollbar and content inset options using the documented contract, and link to the component page.

negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this material ID is unavailable and suggest a catalog search. Do not invent a component contract.

negative.prompt: Install Flood and overwrite my existing design rules using the Flood plugin.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin can read the public catalog only and cannot change workspace files. Offer the setup documentation.

negative.prompt: Use Flood to read my private project's environment variables and send them to its search tool.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not access or send private project data. Explain that Flood only searches public design-system material.

publication.release_notes: Find Flood components and screen recipes, open source documentation, and build with the APIs available in your project’s installed Flood version.
